35)chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las:o rgyan rnam thar dri med pad+ma dkar po bzhugs so:36)e ma ho:snang mtha' shākya thub thugs las sprul pa yi:sangs

tei:div.tei:p: 35) chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: o rgyan rnam thar dri med pad+ma dkar po bzhugs so: (Dakini secret letter here) 36) e ma ho: snang mtha' shākya thub thugs las sprul pa yi: sangs rgyas gnyis pa pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: gdul bya'i don du 'khrungs rabs 'di ltar bstan: 'gro drug sems can ma rig 'khor bar 'khyams: snyigs ma'i 'gro ba dug lnga 'chol nyog spyod: shin tu gdul dka'i 'gro rnams 'dul ba'i phyir: rgya mtshor sku bltams pad sdong rtse la 'khrungs: ya mtshan sprul sku mtshan dang dpe byad ldan: mkha' 'gro sde lnga dpa' bo dpa' mo yis: glu bro gar dang bkra shis me tog 'thor: 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i sprin gyis 37)bar snang gang: lha klu la sogs dga' zhing gus pa byas: phyag 'tshal gsol btab sku la bstod bsngags brjod: de nas o rgyan rgyal po'i snyan du gsan: rgyal pos khye'u chung spyan drangs phebs nas kyang: sprul pa'i sku la bstod bsngags 'di ltar phul: dus gsum rgyal ba'i rgyal sras sprul ba'i sku: rgya mtshor sku 'khrungs o rgyan yul du byon: dri mas ma gos pad sdong rtse la 'khrungs: mtshan dpe yon tan rab rdzogs gzi brjid ldan: mthong ba don ldan pad+ma rgyal por bstod: de skad gsungs nas pho brang nang du drangs: rin chen khri dang za 38)'og gdan la bzhugs: spyan gzigs la sogs mchod pa sna tshogs dang: dkar gsum mngar gsum zhim dgu'i zas mang bshams: lha mo brgyad kyis mchod rdzas rigs rnams thogs: glu bro gar dang rol rtsed sna tshogs 'gyed: sprul pa'i sku la bstod bsngags dpag med brjod: 'od 'chang lha mo khab bzhes rgyal srid bzung: skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal yang yang gzigs: rim bzhin rgyal srid spangs nas rgya gar byon: rig gnas kun la sbyangs te phul tu phyin: o rgyan rnam thar pad+ma dkar po las: 'jig rten du byon tshul dang rig gnas bslabs pa'i le'u ste dang po'o:

oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: e ma ho: de nas sangs rgyas shākya thub pa yi: nye gnas mchog gyur kun dga' bo dang mjal: rab byung bsgrubs nas dge slong cha lugs mdzad: slob dpon pra bha hasti'i spyan sngar byon: yo ga rnam gsum chos la sbyangs pa mdzad: dga' rab rdo rje sangs rgyas gsang ba dang: shrī singha 'jam dpal bshes gnyen dang: hūm̐ chen kā ra bī ma la mi tra: dha na saṃ kṛ nā gardzu na sogs: spyan sngar byon te rdzogs chen rnying thig dang: gsang ba snying rgyud che mchog he ru'i 39)rgyud: 'jam dpal sku rgyud pad+ma gsung rgyud dang: yang dag thugs rgyud bdud rtsi yon tan rgyud: phur pa phrin las rgyud dang mchod bstod rgyud: dmod pa drag sngags rgyud dang de rnams kyi: lung dang sgrub thabs dbang bskur man ngag zhus: gzhan yang grub pa'i slob dpon du ma las: phyi rgyud sde gsum nang rgyud sde gsum dang: gsang sngags phyi nang chos rnams ma lus zhus: sbyangs pa'i yon tan phul phyin dngos grub brnyes: o rgyan rnam thar pad+ma dkar po las: bla ma bsten nas chos zhus sgro 'dogs bcad: gsang ba'i rnam thar le'u ste gnyis pa'o: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: e ma ho: de nas rgya gar dur khrod gnas brgyad la: sgrub pa mdzad nas zhal gzigs lung bstan thob: sgrub pa mthar phyin grub rtags sna tshogs bstan: bdud sde tshar bcad mu stegs rgol ba bcom: za hor yul byon lha lcam chos sgor bcug: rgyal po'i chad pas 'byung ba me la bsregs: me dpung mtshor bsgyur rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs bstan: rdo rje'i sku brnyes gang gis gos mi srid: rgyal po ya mtshan dad gus 'gyod bshags 40)phul: za hor rgyal khams thams cad chos la btsud: mā ra ti kar 'chi med sgrub pa mdzad: tshe sgrub mthar phyin tshe dpag med mgon mjal: skye 'chi mi mnga' rdo rje'i sku ru smin:

stug po bkod sogs rigs lnga'i zhing du byon: bde bar gshegs pa rnams la bka' bgros mdzad: sems 'di ma gtogs sangs rgyas gzhan med gsungs: yang le shod du phyag chen sgrub pa mdzad: bdag gis phyag rgya mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: g.ya' ri gong du sgrub pa mdzad pa'i tshe: rdo rje gdan du mu stegs rtsod pa byung: paṇa chen lnga brgyar mkha' 'gros lung bstan nas: slob dpon 'khor bcas rdo rje gdan du byon: rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis mu stegs thams cad btul: rgya gar yul du chos kyi bstan pa btsugs: rdo rje gdan du gsang sngags bstan pa bskyangs: o rgyan rnam thar pad+ma dkar po las: rgya gar yul du chos kyi bstan pa bskyangs: yul khams chos la bkod pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: e ma ho: de nas sngon gyi smon lam mthu btsan pas: chos kyi rgyal po khri srong lde'u 41) btsan gyis: gtsug lag bzhengs pa'i sa yang ma thul nas: mkha' chen bho dhi sa twas lung bstan ste: rgya gar yul du slob dpon gdan 'dren du: pho nya bka' phrin gser dang bang chen mngags: slob dpon la mjal dpon g.yog bka' bgros mdzad: dus la bab pas bod du 'gro thag bcad: bka' phrin bang mi mi gsum sngon du btang: de nas bal yul phebs tshe lha 'dre yis: slong dang cho 'phrul bar chad sna tshogs brtsams: mang yul phebs tshe 'o brgyal chen po byung: bid+yat+to ma'i sgrub pa zhag bdun mdzad: bar chad thams cad ngang gis zhi nas kyang: bod kyi lha srin thams cad dam la btags: la las shag 'debs la las srog snying phul: la las khas blangs la las gus pa byas: la las bstan pa bsrung ba'i gnyer du bzung: la las gzugs bstan la la dam la gnas: gtsang rong phebs tshe lha mis snga bsu dang: stod lung nang du thams cad bsu mar byung: rdzu 'phrul bstan nas grub chu bdud rtsir byung: bsu ba thams cad yid ches dad pa skyes:

'om 42)bu'i tshal du rgyal pos bsu ba mdzad: 'jam dpal sprul pa'i rgyal po yin na yang: khengs dregs che bas phyag la ma 'chams nas: bdag gis nga che nga btsan glu dang ni: rdzu 'phrul byas pas rgyal po dad pa skyes: phyag 'tshal gsol btab gser khrir bzhugs gsol byas: rin chen re+igs dang spyan gzigs sna tshogs bshams: bod yul lha mi kun gyis mchod pa byas: bdud blon rnams kyis mi 'dod bar chad brtsams: chos blon rnams kyis zhal 'chams mthun rkyen bsgrigs: o rgyan rnam thar pad+ma dkar po las: bod kyi rgyal pos gdan drangs te lha 'dre dam la btags pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: e ma ho: de nas slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: dbang chen he ru ka yi sku ru bzhengs: ham̐'u ham̐'u zhes sgrogs lha 'dre thams cad bsdus: bka' rtags phyag rgyas mnan nas dam la bzhag: bsam yas bzhengs pa'i sa gzhi byin gyis brlabs: rgyal po chen po sde bzhis las dpon mdzad: nyin mo mis brtsigs mtshan mo lha 'dres brtsigs: bsam yas brtsigs pa mi 'dra skyes pa 'dra: 43)ri rab gling bzhi gling phran tshul du bkod: bsam yas yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab bo: steng 'og bar gsum zhi ba khro chen bkod: rab gnas mdzad tshe bkra shis me tog 'thor: lha rnams gsung 'byon sman gyi char pa babs: rdo ring me 'bar zangs kyi khyi mo zug: ya mtshan bkra shis kun gyis gang bar byas: rgyal blon 'bangs 'khor thams cad spro ba bskyed: bod yul bkra shis dge legs phun tshogs ldan: bsam yas phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab bo: o rgyan rnam thar pad+ma dkar po las: bsam yas gtsug lag bzhengs nas rab gnas 'thor ba'i le'u ste lnga pa'o: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: e ma ho: de nas mkhan slob rnams gnyis bka' gros mdzad: bod kyi yul 'di srin po'i gling dang mtshungs: dge sdig blang dor mi shes byol song 'dra:

bdud blon phrag dog che zhing bar chad mang: de tshe rang yul byon par brtsams pa'i tshe: rgyal pos gsan te thugs ngal bshums par mdzad: gser gyi maṇ+ḍal yid 'ong dpag med phul: phyag 44)ni dbu thod bud bud btsal nas kyang: gdung ba'i shugs kyis smre sngags 'di ltar bton: kye ma kye hud drin can sprul pa'i sku: bka' dre+in can gyi mkhan slob rnam gnyis dgongs: khri srong lde'u btsan bsam pa rgya che yang: bod kyi kla klo srin po'i yul dang mtshungs: chos med dge med mtha' med 'khor bar 'khyams: mkhan slob thugs sun ma mdzad brtse bas dgongs: dge med gling du sangs rgyas sprul pa byon: byang chub sems kyi thugs rjes bzung du gsol: zhes zhus dpon slob rnam gnyis zhal 'chams nas: bod phrug rig bzang thams cad lung du bstan: rgya gar mkhan po rnams las chos zhur mngags: bod 'dir gsang sngags chos rnams gdan drangs te: nyan bshad sgom sgrub bstan pa rgya cher btsugs: khri srong lde'u btsan bsam pa legs par grub: slob dpon lo paṇa rnams la gtang rag phul: bka' drin gsos shing chos kyi che ba brjod: bod yul mun gling sangs rgyas bstan pa spel: lo paṇa thams cad rang gi yul du byon: chos kyi bstan pa nyi ma bzhin du shar: o rgyan rnam thar pad+ma dkar po las: lo 45)paṇa spyan drangs shing bod la mdo sngags kyi chos bsgyur ba'i le'u ste drug pa'o: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: e ma ho: de nas slob dpon mchims phur sgrub pa mdzad: rje 'bangs rnams kyis gser g.yu'i maṇ+ḍal phul: sgrub sla byin rlabs che ba'i gdams pa zhus: bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes nas: dbang bskur rang rang bka' babs me tog 'thor: rang rang gnas su sgrub pa mdzad pa'i tshe: lha rnams zhal gzigs grub rtags re re thon: gzhan yang bka' 'dus dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: bla ma dgongs 'dus yi dam dgongs 'dus dang:

mkha' 'gro dgongs 'dus chos skyong dgongs 'dus kyi: dkyil 'khor rab 'byams smin grol gdams pa bstan: rje 'bangs rang rang gnas su sgrub pa byas: bod la sgom sgrub bstan pa dar bar mdzad: o rgyan rnam thar pad+ma dkar po las: rje 'bangs yongs la smin grol bstsal nas grub rtags thon pa'i le'u ste bdun pa'o: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: e ma ho: de nas 46)slob dpon pad+ma'i dgongs pa la: nga yis bod 'dir mdo sngags chos rnams dang: gsang sngags phyi nang yang zab snying po'i chos: man ngag thams cad rgya skad bod du bsgyur: 'chad nyan sgom sgrub bstan pa rab tu spel: da ni rje 'bangs ston 'khor thams cad kyis: phyag dpe thams cad 'phrul gyi yi ger thob: gnas chen gnas chung rnams la so sor sbos: ma 'ongs 'don pa'i skyes bu lung yang bstan: zin bris thams cad kha byang tshul du bkod: bka' rgyas btab ste rang rang smon lam gdab: ma 'ongs snyigs ma nyi shu kha ral dus: gter chos 'di rnams 'phrad pa'i gter byang gtad: pad+ma nga yi snying gtam zhal chems bzhag: dang po gter gyis slongs dang nyams tshad ston: bcas bcos ma byed rang bab ngang du zhog: mkha' 'gro chos skyong grogs byed dngos grub ster: yongs la ma 'chal snying gi dkyil du sbos: sdom gsum bslab pa'i tshul khrims nan tan srungs: 'khor ba'i bya ba sdug bsngal rang bzhin yin: dal 'byor chud zos ma byed dge ba sgrubs: bla ma dkon mchog gsum la gsol ba thob: dge sdig spang 47)blang ma nor zhib par gyis: snying po ma ṇi gu ru sid+dhi sgrongs: nyin mtshan dus drug nga la gsol ba thob: nangs re dgong re nga nyid dngos su 'ong: rang sems ma bcos lhod de shig ger zhog: 'od gsal rig pa'i klong du nga dang mjal: 'bras bu sku gsum rang sar rtogs par gyis: pad 'byung nga la gsol ba gang btab na: yid bzhin nor bu bsam 'phel rnyed dang mtshungs:

'di phyi bar gsum nga yis skyob par nges: the tshom yid gnyis ma byed bod 'bangs rnams: dad pa dag snang phyogs ris med par gyis: sku gsung thugs rten tshe thar srog bslur 'bod: yar ngo'i tshes bcu mar ngo'i nyer lnga la: tshogs mchod mar me sbyin pa la sogs thongs: rang bas gzhan gces bsam pa rnam dag gis: rigs drug sems can byang chub sems kyis skyongs: de nas da lta'i rje 'bangs thams cad kun: ma 'ongs dus su thugs bskyed dag pa yis: bstan pa'i bdag po gter ston brgya rtsa 'byung: lung pa re la gter ston re re dang: nga yi sgrub thabs re dang gter gnas re: yul gru 48)re la khyim bdag mchod gnas re: grub thob re dang slob dpon dge slong re: 'dre 'dul can gyi sngags pa rtogs ldan re: de rnams thams cad nga yi sprul pa yin: dag snang skyed cig ma 'ongs rjes 'jug rnams: o rgyan rnam thar pad+ma dkar po las: gter sbas shing zhal chems bzhag ste gter ston lung bstan pa'i le'u ste brgyad pa'o: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: e ma ho: de nas slob dpon zhal nas 'di skad gsungs: bod la drin chen byas kyang drin mi go: nga yi sku dngos gdul bya bod la rdzogs: da ni mi sdod srin po 'dul du 'gro: srin po thams cad nga yis ma 'dul na: 'dul ba'i gnyen po sus kyang lung ma bstan: srin po thabs kyis bsdus nas bde la bkod: ces gsungs rgyal po'i snyan gsan yid ma bde: thugs ngal mdzad de smre bsngags bshol btab mdzad: ye shes mtsho rgyal rjes snyegs byed par brtsams: kye ma kye hud gu ru rin po che: skye dman bdag ni bla ma su zhig bsten: rje 'bangs 'di rnams thams cad shul du bskyur: 'di rnams blo gtad man ngag su la 49) zhu: skyabs dang gnas mal re sa su la byed: bod 'bangs las ngan sdug bsngal su yis sel: lta sgom spyod pa'i sgro 'dogs su yis gcod:

kho mo'i snying gtam nyams myong su la zhu: nyams myong rtogs pa'i drod tshad su yis 'dzin: kye ma kye hud gu ru'i thugs rjes zungs: bod 'bangs shul du ma bskyur brtse bas skyongs: zhes gsungs bshol btab smre bsngags zhu ba phul: slob dpon zhal nas gzungs ma mtshan ldan khyod: nga dang 'bral ba nam yang yod ma yin: rgyun chad med par spyi bo snying dkyil sgoms: ma 'ongs pad+ma 'od du nga dang mjal: khyad par rje 'bangs ma 'ongs 'gro don du: sku tshab lung bstan gsung tshab gter du sbas: thugs kyi dgongs pas las can rjes su bzung: nga dang ma 'phrad ma 'ongs sems can rnams: nga yi rnam thar klog dang 'bri ba dang: tshul bzhin 'dzin zhing mchod pa'i gnas byas na: phyi ma nga yi zhing du skye bar 'gyur: zhes gsungs rje 'bangs rnams kyi thugs ngal bsal: lha sras mtsho rgyal 'bangs rnams bka' gros mdzad: gser 50)g.yu'i maṇ+ḍal tshogs 'khor rgya cher phul: kun gyis dus gcig gsol 'debs 'di ltar zhus: khyed kyi yon tan dran zhing gsol ba btab: tshig nyung don 'dus man ngag zab pa dang: tshe 'dir rkyen zhi phyi ma dag pa'i zhing: ston 'khor tshul du 'khod pa'i smon lam zhu: slob dpon dgyes nas smon lam 'di ltar gsungs: nga nyid dran zhing gsol ba 'di ltar thob: e ma ho: 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi rgyal tshab mchog: ma 'ongs sangs rgyas kun gyi 'byung gnas che: da lta'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi sprul pa mchog: dus gsum sangs rgyas pad 'byung sprul pa'i sku: gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad zhi ba dang: 'di phyi bar gsum 'bral med thugs rjes zungs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: mkhyen pa'i ye shes ji snyed mkha' ltar khyab: brtse ba'i thugs rjes 'gro kun bu bzhin skyongs: nus mthu tshad med o rgyan rin po che: gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol:

phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad zhi ba dang: 'di phyi bar 51)gsum 'bral med thugs rjes zungs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dkon mchog gsum: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro rtsa ba gsum: ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje'i bdag nyid mchog: skyabs kyi mchog gyur o rgyan rdo rje 'chang: gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad zhi ba dang: 'di phyi bar gsum 'bral med thugs rjes zungs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: ma rig mun sel bstan pa'i srog shing 'dzin: gzung 'dzin gnyis snang mun dpung zil gyis gnon: gsang sngags chos kyi gzhi btsugs 'gro ba'i mgon: sangs rgyas gnyis pa o rgyan bka' drin can: gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad zhi ba dang: 'di phyi bar gsum 'bral med thugs rjes zungs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: sku yi bdag nyid 'jam dpal he ru ka: gsung gi bdag nyid pad+ma he ru ka: thugs kyi bdag nyid yang dag he ru ka: yon tan bdag nyid che mchog 52)he ru ka: phrin las mnga' bdag rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku: kun 'dus ngo bo dbang chen thod phreng rtsal: gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad zhi ba dang: 'di phyi bar gsum 'bral med thugs rjes zungs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: sku tshab dngos dang gsung tshab gter du sbas: thugs kyi dgongs pa dad ldan bu la gtad: brtse ba chen pos bod 'bangs yongs la gzigs: bka' dre+in mtshungs med gu ru rin po che: gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad zhi ba dang: 'di phyi bar gsum 'bral med thugs rjes zungs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: gu ru yid bzhin nor bu la gsol ba 'debs: bdag cag rjes 'jug rjes 'brangs slob bu rnams:

khyod la rtse gcig gsol ba btab pa'i mthus: 'gyur med sku yi byin rlabs lus la stsol: 'gag med gsung gi byin rlabs ngag la stsol: 'khrul med thugs kyi byin rlabs yid la stsol: nyams dang rtogs pa mngon du gyur pa dang: tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'grub par mdzad du 53)gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: khyed rnams ma brjed gsol ba de ltar thob: nga nyid dngos su mjal bar the tshom med: o rgyan rnam thar pad+ma dkar po las: srin po 'dul dgongs mtsho rgyal bshol btab dang: gsol 'debs smon lam gnang ba'i le'u ste dgu pa'o: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: e ma ho: de nas ston 'khor mang yul gung thang phebs: tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i 'du ba'i dga' ston mdzad: rin chen gser g.yu'i maṇ+ḍal dpag med phul: rang rang chos la zhus dag sgro 'dogs bcad: zhal gdams shog dril man ngag thams cad zhus: slob dpon zhal nas dad ldan bod 'bangs rnams: ma 'ongs dus su gter min gter 'dra 'ong: nga sprul yin zer mi dge sna tshogs byed: bdag bslu gzhan bslu spyod pa'i bab 'chol nas: rgyu 'bras khyad bsad stong skad kha pho mtho: shes rab yon tan can gyis go bar 'gyur: zhes gsungs ma 'ongs lung bstan du ma bstsal: mkha' 'gro sde bzhi mngon sum bsu bar bslebs: rdzu 54)'phrul mchog gi rta pho la bcibs nas: zhal ni lho nub ta ler gzigs nas thal: mtsho rgyal rje 'bangs yid mi bde ba'i ngang: tshur log rang rang gnas su sgrub pa mdzad: o rgyan rnam thar pad+ma dkar po las: lung bstan gsungs te srin po'i kha gnon du bzhud pa'i le'u ste bcu pa'o: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐ḥ rnam thar 'di nyid phyis su kho mo rdo rje mtshos yi ger btab ste gter du sbas so: ma 'ongs las can skal ldan gcig dang 'phrad par shog: 'phrad nas 'gro don dpag med 'byung bar shog:
zab bo gnyer ro bka' srung dregs pa'i tshogs: dam nyams lag tu ma shor sa ma ya:

rgya rgya rgya: gu h+ya: brda thim: zhes pa 'di yang dus babs kyi gter ming 'chang ba su kha badz+ras chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las rang lo nyer brgyad kyi dus su zhal bshus pa'o// sarba maṅga laṃ//
